title: image-lock-and-runner-matrix-for-load-harness
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Create a reproducible, minimal permutation matrix for load harness runs by locking container images (digest/signature), tagging runtime ABI variants, and defining a quarantine/launcher mapping for runners. This ticket delivers: (1) an image-locking convention and CI enforcement job that fails builds if an image tag is not pinned to a digest or signature; (2) a canonical driver/CUDA permutation file used by the load-harness matrix generator; (3) runner isolation labels (quarantine zones) for flaky drivers so experiments don't pollute baseline runs; (4) integration with perf dashboards to map runs to golden-baseline IDs for regression detection.

Why now: Recent CI noise and spurious regressions correlate with transitive changes in base images and unpinned runner images. We need a lightweight, auditable contract so nightly and PR-driven benchmarks are comparable to previous runs and regression alerts are actionable.

Acceptance criteria:
- Image locking: all benchmark runner images used by the load harness must be pinned to content digests or signed manifests; a new CI job (ci/bench/image-lock) rejects unknown tags.
- Driver/CUDA matrix: publish drivers-matrix.csv in the repo root with explicit [driver-version,cuda-version,kernel-compat] rows; matrix must be consumable by the matrix-generator tool.
- Runner quarantine: label runners with quarantine=true when a driver/node exhibits >3 failing harness runs in a 24h window; quarantined runners are excluded from production baseline sweeps and used only for exploratory/compat tests.
- Matrix generator: matrix-generator produces deterministic job permutations given drivers-matrix.csv and image-lock.json; outputs job hash used in run metadata.
- Perf tagging: each harness run attaches fields: image_digest, driver_version, cuda_version, job_hash, golden_baseline_id; dashboards link to these for p95 and tokens/sec comparisons.
- Regression detection: perf-alerting rule fires when token/sec p95 regresses by >7% vs golden baseline for 3 consecutive runs.

Plan / Implementation steps:
1) Spec image-lock schema and CI hook (owner: infra-qa). Minimum fields: image_name, digest, signed_by(optional), build_sha, created_at.
2) Add drivers-matrix.csv and automated sanity checks (owner: runtime). Start with curated stable set: (nvidia-driver-525, cuda-12.1), (nvidia-driver-535, cuda-12.2), plus one older LTS for backward coverage.
3) Implement runner-quarantine controller (k8s controller) that observes harness job failures and flips runner label; provide CLI to force-unquarantine.
4) Extend load-harness to record job_hash and image_digest in run metadata and emit to perf ingestion.
5) Create CI job ci/bench/image-lock that runs on PRs touching images or harness configs.
6) Add docs: confluence page with matrix generation instructions and troubleshooting checklist.

Trade-offs and notes:
- We choose digest-based pinning over tag-only pinning to maximize reproducibility; trade-off is operational overhead when rotating base images.
- Quarantine helps reduce baseline noise but risks hiding systemic issues; quarantine TTL will be 72h by default and require manual review for extension.
- We are NOT changing runner binaries or kernel kernels; this ticket standardizes discovery and labeling rather than performing driver upgrades.

Rollout:
- Week 1: land schema, ci job, and drivers-matrix.csv in feature branch; run nightly synthetic sweep against current golden baseline.
- Week 2: enable PR blocking for image-lock on bench infra changes; start quarantining noisy runners in read-only mode (labels set but not excluded) and analyze impact.
- Week 3: enforce quarantine exclusion in baseline jobs and enable perf-alert rule; monitor false positives for one week then refine threshold.

Risks / Mitigations:
- Risk: pinning images may cause CI breakage when upstream images are removed. Mitigation: maintain a small cache of pinned images in our registry and a restore runbook.
- Risk: aggressive quarantine could shrink available runner pool causing capacity issues. Mitigation: set conservative quarantine thresholds and provide an override path.

Notes for reviewers: check the drivers-matrix.csv for completeness and the initial image-lock.json examples in the branch. The matrix-generator output includes a stable job_hash which we will use to back-reference golden baselines in dashboards.

2026-03-06 - Priya Menon (runtime reviewer): Suggest adding kernel-compat column to drivers-matrix.csv to capture host ABI constraints. Also recommend starting with a tiny curated set to avoid combinatorial explosion.
